items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 4788.8/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-05-12 was Rs 4788.8/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 1210.73-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +94.0% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 9292.57/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 4788.8/MWh, a +94.0% divergence.

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 184% of daily average
items.detail: Max-min spread of Rs 10000.0 - Rs 1210.73 = 184% of the daily average, indicating high intraday volatility.
